records.name: Girl Scouts of the USA
records.mission: Girl Scouting builds girls of courage, confidence, and character, who make the world a better place through skill-building, outdoor adventures, community service, and entrepreneurship.

records.name: Safe Horizon Inc
records.mission: To provide support, prevent violence, and promote justice for victims of crime and abuse, their families and communities, operating emergency residential shelters, legal counseling, and trauma recovery programs for women and children.

records.name: Anita Borg Institute for Women and Technology (AnitaB.org)
records.mission: To connect, inspire, and guide women in computing and organizations that view technology innovation as a strategic imperative, hosting the Grace Hopper Celebration and driving tech diversity research.

records.name: Women for Women International
records.mission: To help female survivors of war and conflict rebuild their lives, providing year-long social and economic empowerment programs, vocational skills, health education, and rights awareness across conflict zones.

records.name: Rape Abuse and Incest National Network (RAINN)
records.mission: To operate the National Sexual Assault Hotline, carry out programs to prevent sexual violence, help survivors, and ensure that perpetrators are brought to justice through public education, forensic assistance, and victim advocacy.

records.name: Sanctuary for Families Inc
records.mission: Dedicated to the safety, healing, and self-determination of victims of domestic violence and sex trafficking and their children through clinical counseling, legal representation, emergency shelter, and economic empowerment.

records.name: National Women's Law Center
records.mission: To fight for gender justice in the courts, in public policy, and in our society, working across issues of equal pay, workplace pregnancy accommodations, Title IX educational parity, and child care access.
records.primary_focus: Legal Defense, Equal Pay & Title IX

records.name: Girls Who Code Inc
records.mission: To close the gender gap in technology and change the image of what a programmer looks like and does, equipping girls and young women with computing skills, engineering internships, and tech industry career pathways.

records.name: Girls Inc (Girls Incorporated)
records.mission: To inspire all girls to be strong, smart, and bold through direct service and advocacy, equipping girls to navigate gender, economic, and social barriers to grow up healthy, educated, and independent.

records.name: Global Fund for Women
records.mission: To fund grassroots gender justice movements, feminist organizers, and frontline community leaders advancing women's safety, economic justice, bodily autonomy, and climate resilience worldwide.

records.name: Women's World Banking Inc
records.mission: To design and invest in financial solutions, microloans, digital financial capabilities, and policy environments in emerging markets to create greater economic stability and prosperity for low-income women.

records.name: National Domestic Violence Hotline
records.mission: To answer the call to support and shift power back to those affected by relationship abuse, providing 24/7/365 confidential crisis intervention, safety planning, and trauma-informed support for women and families nationwide.

records.name: Polaris Project Inc
records.mission: To combat and eradicate modern sex and labor human trafficking, operate the National Human Trafficking Hotline, and provide trauma-informed support and restorative services to victimized women and minors.

records.name: YWCA USA Inc
records.mission: Eliminating racism, empowering women, standing up for social justice, helping families, and strengthening communities through women's crisis shelters, childcare, career training, and gender equity programs.

records.name: Downtown Women's Center
records.mission: Dedicated exclusively to ending homelessness for women in greater Los Angeles through permanent supportive housing, emergency day center services, physical and mental health clinics, and workforce development.

records.name: Society of Women Engineers (SWE)
records.mission: Empower women to achieve full potential in careers as engineers and leaders, expand the image of the engineering and technology professions as a positive force in improving the quality of life, and demonstrate the value of diversity.

records.name: N Street Village Inc
records.mission: To support women experiencing homelessness in Washington DC by offering a broad spectrum of services including supportive housing, substance abuse recovery, mental health care, and vocational training in an affirming community.

records.name: Ovarian Cancer Research Alliance (OCRA)
records.mission: To eradicate ovarian cancer and related gynecologic cancers by funding scientific breakthroughs, supporting patients through compassionate survivor support programs, and advocating for national research funding.

records.name: National Network to End Domestic Violence
records.mission: To represent state domestic violence coalitions and work to make domestic violence a national priority, eradicate domestic violence, and ensure survivor safety, support, and trauma-informed economic stability across all communities.

records.name: Dress for Success Worldwide
records.mission: To empower women to achieve economic independence by providing a network of support, professional attire, career development tools, financial literacy classes, and leadership mentorship.

records.name: Sarah's Circle Inc
records.mission: To serve women who are homeless or in need of a safe space, providing daytime drop-in support, interim emergency housing, permanent supportive apartments, and case management focused on ending chronic female homelessness.

records.name: Every Mother Counts
records.mission: To make pregnancy and childbirth safe for every mother, everywhere, by investing in community-based maternal health programs, training midwives and doulas, and improving access to quality maternity care in underserved communities.

records.name: Legal Action Center - Women's Rights Project
records.mission: To advocate for the civil rights and legal protections of women experiencing discrimination, substance use recovery, criminal justice re-entry, and employment barriers.

records.name: National Black Mamas Matter Alliance
records.mission: To advocate for maternal health, rights, and justice, shift culture, and lead research and holistic care models that advance Black maternal health and wellness.

records.name: National Breast Cancer Coalition Fund
records.mission: To end breast cancer through biomedical research, collaborative clinical initiatives, quality healthcare access, and evidence-based science training for patient advocates.

records.name: Nontraditional Employment for Women (NEW)
records.mission: To prepare, train, and place women in careers in skilled construction, electrical, carpentry, utility, and maintenance trades, helping women achieve economic self-sufficiency with union-wage careers.

records.name: Womens Initiative for Self Employment
records.mission: To build financial equity and wealth for low-income and underserved women through entrepreneurship training, micro-enterprise loans, mentorship, and business incubation.

records.name: Center for Women and Enterprise
records.mission: To empower women to become economically self-sufficient and prosperous through comprehensive business education, enterprise consulting, certification, and capital access programs.

records.name: Step Up Women's Network
records.mission: To guide girls and gender-expansive young adults to fulfill their potential by empowering them to become confident, college-bound, career-focused, and ready to join the next generation of professional leaders.

records.name: Society for Maternal-Fetal Medicine Foundation
records.mission: To improve pregnancy outcomes and reduce maternal morbidity and mortality by advancing research, education, and optimal clinical standards in high-risk pregnancy care.

records.name: Association for Women in Science (AWIS)
records.mission: To champion women in science, technology, engineering, and mathematics, advocating for workplace equity, fair compensation, career advancement, and leadership opportunities across academic, industrial, and government sectors.
